notes: Piece count matches the parts list: 97 pieces. The minifigure (head, torso, legs, miner hat, headlamp) is not in the supplied parts list, so it is not recorded.

The boulder (b10-b19: bottom, 6 round plates, 2 crystals, top) is deliberately left as a separate component. The booklet builds it as its own small model on p.5, and p.24 shows it standing on the ground next to the truck, not attached to anything. Joining it to the truck would invent a connection the booklet does not show, so the two-component graph is correct for this set.

The sign (b1-b3) sits loose in the crate and the crate (b20, holding pickaxe, extinguisher and dynamite) sits loose in the truck bed, as shown on p.24. The sign is also shown on p.5 outside the crate; I used the p.24 arrangement.
b75 (jumper 3794b) rests on the yellow bed plate b67, and the 2x2 tile b74 rests on bed plates b66/b67. Nothing rests on a tile.
The pickaxe b21 is shown in the crate on p.5 and on the roll bar on the cover. I recorded it in the crate only.

The booklet has no part callouts, so piece identities and positions were inferred from the pictures and the parts list. Which of the 6 round plates and which cheese slopes go where is a best guess; the colour/type counts are exact.
Stud-to-stud stacking is recorded in rests_on, including pieces attached sideways to the 14520 rear and front assemblies. Hinge, clip, pin and loose-in-container links are in other_joins.

Truck order: base b22; two 3021 plates under the base ends carry the 6157 wheel holders; seat, steering stand and 1x2 brick; sloped 6x1 bricks with black 1x4 plates in their recesses; gray 1x2x2 bricks; 4 wheel arches; rear 14520 lights assembly; red front handle plate; 2x4 plate; front grille assembly; hood; dash plates; doors; bed plates; bed sides; roll bar; pillars; roof (3023 trans-red + 45677); wheels.
The wheels b89-b96 are not placed on the truck by rests_on. Each pair of wheel and tyre is joined to its 6157 holder by a pin.
The sticker sheet b97 is one piece. The booklet shows stickers on the roof and the licence plate only, so those are the two joins recorded.
